title: Ɔyɔnkofo a Onhinhim wɔ Sikakɔkɔɔ Sɔhwɛ Mu
intro: Wɔ odiyifo kɛse bi sunsuma mu no, wɔpaw ɔkra a ɔka kasa yiye na ɔwɔ gyidi sɛ ɔmmoa wɔ asɛmpatrɛw adwuma kɛse bi mu. Saa akontaabu yi gyinaa pintinn bere a nnipadɔm no wosow wɔn ho, na wɔkaa asɛm no tiaa mmarato bi a ɛda adi pefee a ɛde onyame biako som titiriw no too asiane mu no. Bere a odiyifo no san bae sɛ ɔrebɛhwɛ sɛnea nkurɔfo no adi mfomso no, na saa onipa yi ayi ne ho ano nyɛ afobu na mmom asɛyɛde ne mpaapaemu ho suro. Hena ne Allah akoa a wahyira ne ho yi?
clues: Allah na ɔpaw me maa asɛdeɛ kronkron bi a ɛka ɔfoforo ho, na na me dwumadie yɛ mmoa ne mpaemuka.
Wɔmaa me kasa mu pefee, na me ne ɔbɔfo bi kɔhyiaa nhyɛsofo bi a ɔwɔ tumi.
Wɔ akwantu bi a emu yɛ den mu no, ɔbɔfo no nkutoo foroo bepɔw bi, na ogyaw me sɛ menhwɛ nkurɔfo no.
Bere a na wonni hɔ no, nkurɔfo no yɛɛ sika ohoni, na mesrɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔ so nni nokware, nanso wɔpow m’afotu no.
Bere a ɔbɔfo no san bae a abufuw ne awerɛhow ahyɛ no ma no, wɔkyeree me, nanso mekyerɛkyerɛɛ mu sɛ wɔadi me so nkonim na misuro sɛ mede akasakasa bɛba wɔn ntam.
Mene nkɔmhyɛni a megyinaa Musa, me nua no nkyɛn, na mekyɛ n’adesoa na mekɔɔ so pintinn tiaa abosonsom.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Ná nkurɔfo som sika nantwi ba ɛmfa ho kɔkɔbɔ ahorow no
Nkurɔfo tow me guu ogya a ɛredɛw mu
Wɔde me too afiase wɔ atoro sobo ahorow ho
Wɔpam me fii me kurom esiane asɛnka nti
trial.answer: Ná nkurɔfo som sika nantwi ba ɛmfa ho kɔkɔbɔ ahorow no

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Wobuu me bem na metoaa me nkɔmhyɛ asɛmpatrɛw adwuma no so
Wɔtwee m’aso wɔ nkurɔfo no bɔne ho
Wɔmaa me ɔman foforo sɛ menkyerɛ me kwan
Wɔde me kɔɔ soro a na mete ase
outcome.answer: Wobuu me bem na metoaa me nkɔmhyɛ asɛmpatrɛw adwuma no so

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant. (25:35)
